issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain shop.testfunnel.example had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, while the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on their own domain.

issues.title: Secure certificate (padlock) check
issues.problem_statement: After the domain was connected, support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear and committed to check that it has been issued.

items.description: Customer opened the domain in an incognito window following support's guidance and reported the same error, ruling out a browser cache issue.
evidence: Opened in incognito. Still the same error.
so it is not a browser cache issue

items.description: Customer checked the domain status in the FlexiFunnels dashboard following support's guidance and saw that it showed "Not connected".
evidence: It says "Not connected" next to the domain.

items.description: Support explained that an old A record for shop pointing to an old server address, left by a previous developer, was blocking the connection, and that it should be replaced with a CNAME record for shop using the target value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.
add a CNAME record for shop, using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record for shop and added a CNAME record for shop at their domain registrar following support's guidance, saved it, and the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and shop.testfunnel.example loaded.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.
The dashboard now shows the domain as connected.

items.description: Support explained that www.shop.testfunnel.example still showed an error page because a second record for www pointed somewhere else, and that it should be deleted and replaced with a CNAME for www with the same target value.
evidence: you have a second record for www pointing somewhere else

items.description: Customer deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value following support's guidance, saved both changes, and confirmed that both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version load the funnel.
evidence: Both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version are loading our funnel now.

items.description: Support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting

items.description: Support will check the next morning that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.
